intent.proves: Updates from the build's own update provider are recorded as applied.
intent.scope: rows of Updates whose UpdateProviderName is a provider in the build's customAssemblies input

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Updates WHERE UpdateProviderName = N'<provider>'
bindings.reason: Needs the provider name as a runtime token, which contract.md does not define; the built-in provider naming is unverified, so no name pattern is guessed.
